scene_purpose: Establish scale, isolation and historical atmosphere of the 1908 Siberian taiga before the event.
main_subject: Endless conifer forest under morning mist, a winding river catching warm low sunlight.

camera.angle: Aerial establishing shot, roughly 300-400 m altitude, pitched ~20 degrees below horizon
camera.composition: River leads the eye from lower-center toward the misty horizon in the upper third; forested ridges layer left and right; bright sky break upper-left as the single warm accent.

lighting.direction: Low sun from upper-left, slightly toward camera (semi-backlit)
lighting.intensity_and_character: Soft warm sunlight breaking through clouds; mist diffuses it into visible shafts; cool blue-gray fill everywhere else.

foreground_elements: dense conifer canopy with individual crowns readable
midground_elements: winding river with warm sky reflection
background_elements: cloud deck with one bright break
environmental_details: height variation between young and mature trees
animation_opportunities: slow aerial glide forward (matches s1 camera)
must_preserve: single warm sky accent against cool scene
can_simplify: individual tree crowns beyond 1km (use far forest with castShadow=false)
river to an emissive-tinted ribbon mesh

engine_mapping.world: world({ skyEl: 1.5-3, skyAz: 70, fog: 0.0016-0.0019, fogColor: '#8a8aa0' -> lerp '#d0a070' near sun })
engine_mapping.forest: near: makeForest(treesIn({spacing: 4.2}), {geometry: geo.living(1)}); far: treesIn({spacing: 7, scale: [13,22]}), castShadow=false, as in s1_dawn_fireball.js
engine_mapping.terrain: makeTerrain + heightAt (fbm octaves 4); river: add a ribbon mesh following a low fbm contour, MeshStandardMaterial with env reflections
engine_mapping.light: sunLight colour '#ffd2a0' low elevation; skyEnvironment for ambient
engine_mapping.camera: PerspectiveCamera fov ~46, slow dolly as in s1
